reviewed_by: Codex focused review of Butler harness gateway activation
reason: Three Python cases cover the previously failing project Butler catalog, scoped Butler gateway access, and a scheduled global analysis opening its gateway with a durable harness turn. The analysis case also checks local runtime scope from the owning harness session.
exclusions: No UI, API contract, frontend, browser, or native source changed. The selected cases exercise both affected Butler harness entry points; unrelated suites and Playwright areas are excluded. A synthetic LAN Core and the promoted simulation Core provide runtime acceptance evidence separately.
